messages:
marta (AE): Quick sync: Prospect 'HealthGrid' wants to replace CompetitorDelta with Redwood. Scope: 3-week POC, API compatibility (streaming + response fields), procurement-friendly invoicing, and no regression on their 'clinical_intent' field. Decision timeline: 28 days. Any immediate blockers?
lucas (SE): I'll take the adapter. Their client expects newline-delimited JSON chunks with top-level `session_id` and incremental `clinical_intent` updates. Need to preserve chunk ordering and the partial intent updates. Do we have sample traces?
marta (AE): They uploaded a redacted bundle to S3 (link in DM). ~700 sessions + QPS profile per region. Also included their current per-token billing docs.
ben (SRE): Ops note: tokenization mismatch likely (CompetitorDelta tokenizer differs). Recommend parity run on 400-600 prompts to estimate token uplift. Streaming semantics: they rely on flush-per-chunk; we'll need to emulate that at the proxy layer.
ana (Security): Heads-up: security questionnaire requires SAML SSO, SCIM, KMS with rotation, and SOC2 evidence. For PHI they may require Dedicated/Private. For POC they may accept hosted under DPA + contractual restrictions. If they insist on VPC peering for PII, add ~2 days to timeline.
tom (Finance): Pricing ask: they want an invoiceable POC that maps to CompetitorDelta's model. We can offer POC credits to match effective per-token cost, plus a short onboarding rebate if they commit to a baseline Dedicated contract. Need projected tokens/day and peak QPS.
lucas (SE): Adapter sketch: proxy /delta/v1/stream -> call /v1/responses?stream=true. Map payload.messages->input.text, preserve session_id, and rewrite Redwood deltas to their chunk schema. Pseudocode:
```
POST /delta/stream
for chunk in inbound:
  call redwood(stream=true)
  for delta in redwood_stream:
    attach session_id
    if delta.intent present -> emit chunk with clinical_intent
    else -> emit chunk with clinical_intent: null
```
Also add a normalizer to inject expected keys when missing.
ben (SRE): Validation plan: dual-write canary (forward live traffic to Redwood + CompetitorDelta) for 72h, log responses, run schema-diff and semantic comparator daily. We'll surface regressions and compute delta rates. Expect extra egress/storage costs.
ana (Security): I'll start the questionnaire draft. Call out KMS rotation SLAs, optional HSM availability, log redaction, and retention limits. Need their compliance contact for SOC2 artifacts.
marta (AE): They asked for an automated rollback if we detect regressions mid-POC. Can we implement a circuit-breaker to flip traffic to CompetitorDelta if schema_mismatch_rate or quality_drop exceed thresholds?
ben (SRE): Yes — implementable in the proxy layer. Need a monitoring job to compute metrics and an infra playbook. Will estimate cost.
lucas (SE): I'll also build a small eval harness: run 250 ground-truth pairs they provided -> check key-presence + embedding similarity for text fields. Produce daily report.
tom (Finance): Note: dual-write and comparator will add egress and logging costs. I'll add line items and propose a credit cap for POC.
canary-bot: Reminder: POC sandbox provisioning ticket #7421 will start in ~90 minutes.
marta (AE): Action items: lucas -> adapter prototype + normalizer by Tue EOD; ben -> tokenizer script + infra/egress estimate by Tue noon; ana -> security Q draft + network diagram by Mon EOD; tom -> POC credit terms by Tue. 30min sync Wed 10am PT.
lucas (SE): ack. I'll share a comparator script: `./tools/resp_diff --gold=competitordelta.json --cand=redwood.json --metrics=schema,semantic`
ana (Security): I'll flag EU data residency if they process EU patients. That may push POC to Dedicated for in-region hosting.
marta (AE): Who can join Wed 10am?
lucas (SE): me.
ben (SRE): me.
ana (Security): me.
tom (Finance): tentative.
marta (AE): I'll send the invite and attach the sample bundle + starter adapter spec. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
